name: SLA tiers
text:
Based on the SLA document I found, here are the uptime tiers and corresponding credit levels for the Northstar Platform:

## Uptime Tiers and Credits

**Availability Tiers:**
- Enterprise: 99.99% monthly uptime
- Professional: 99.9% monthly uptime
- Starter: 99.5% monthly uptime

**Service Credits:**
- 99.9-99.99%: 10% credit
- 99-99.9%: 25% credit
- 95-99%: 50% credit
- <95%: 100% credit

The SLA also specifies that credits are calculated based on the difference between the actual uptime achieved and the guaranteed uptime tier. For example, if an Enterprise customer receives 99.98% uptime instead of the guaranteed 99.99%, they would receive a 10% credit for that month.

Note: The SLA excludes credits for scheduled maintenance (Sundays 2-6 AM PST with 72-hour notice), customer-caused issues, force majeure events, third-party outages, and beta features.
